metrics.recall: All scheduled valid-page attempts; detector_failed contributes every GT instance as FN.
metrics.false_positives_per_page: Successful fully annotated valid-page attempts only, per mode; failed pages prohibit full-corpus FP claims.
metrics.mask_iou: Only checksummed mask pairs with documented mapping; failed valid-page attempts contribute zero.
metrics.failure_rate: All scheduled valid-page attempts, separate from successful-page FP.
metrics.latency: Per mode and device, completed attempts only; expose failures, watchdogs and censored attempts separately.
metrics.memory: Physical-device PSS separately from Java/native allocations; no host-to-device equivalence.

gates.record_validity: No invalid evidence, missing attempts, missing assets or provenance mismatch.
gates.product_quality: BLOCKED until real corpus admitted and baseline measured; numeric regression thresholds await approval.
gates.device: BLOCKED until physical Pixel 8 Pro and Samsung A12 evidence captured.

statistical_scope: Paired identical corpus and policy. Source-family clustered uncertainty; repeated attempts do not increase independent page count. Holdout cannot tune thresholds.
